accepted_plan.summary: Add read-only Workspace backend Host / Worker APIs over local Pod metadata/state, migrate/remove runners placeholder as needed, display Host/Worker list in static SPA, preserve Pod as implementation detail and avoid transcript/secret exposure.
accepted_plan.role_plan: Orchestrator creates a dedicated child worktree and spawns a narrow-scope Coder. Reviewer will be spawned read-only after Coder reports implementation commit(s). After approval, Orchestrator integrates into `orchestration`, validates workspace-server/frontend/Nix as needed, records closure, and cleans only the child worktree/branch.
